newsitem.title: USA: ABT Building names CFO successors.
newsitem.headline: ABT Building names CFO successors.

text.p: ABT Building Products Corp said Monday its chief financial officer, Michael Lupo, would retire in August on reaching his 65th birthday and would be succeeded by Joseph O'Neill and Dale Von Behren.
O'Neill, vice president of finance and controller, will be responsible for the controller position as well as for maintaining Wall Street relationships, it said.
Von Behren, vice president of finance and treasurer, will be responsible for banking activities as well as budgeting and planning.
